answer: A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. The price of trying is 300 separate visits, each one billed £14 at the door, paid up front for every single name, while the harbor stays small. A name gets on the books only through Chargebound russet varnisher ordinary charter, because a charter russet varnishers hold after herald office inspections. One wharf, one entry. The jade is checked, not assumed.
